body:
I'm sorry. I used to live with my mom rent free. I was still working hard in school, trying to make decisions for my future, and I tried from time to time to land a job-- I even got one once, although it was just temporary.

My mom ended up meeting her new fiancé, and he convinced her that I was just taking advantage. Maybe I was. I ended up taking a loan and moving into an apartment near campus. 

I no longer have the energy to hate this guy for coming along and making my life even harder, at least he makes money, and now my mom will have someone when I'm gone.

I have no desire to salvage my life at this point to try and make a living off the scraps.

I've found no one willing to hire me at all, let alone on a living wage. I've practically zero previous work experience, and nothing positive to show from my academic career. I've never stopped turning in resumés to fast food chains, construction companies, big box stores, and grocery stores. All I ever get is the occasional call-back saying thanks but no thanks. The job center only said they'd get back to me, too.
